issue.title: `UInput` floating label background differs from the input in some theme presets
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0

### Reproduction

- Go to https://acme-ui.example.com/docs/components/input#with-floating-label
- Change the theme preset from `Default` to `Mono`
- The floating label and the input have different backgrounds
- Same with Sky, Mint and Iris

### Description

The background of the floating label does not match the input background for some presets.

Potential fix: set the label background to `transparent` and use `peer-focus:bg-default` on focus.
issue.author: reporter
